name: 24210 · Abingdon, VA
findings: ZIP 24210 (Abingdon) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24210 (Abingdon) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 24210 (Abingdon) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 28.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
